verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs mention a disclosure component that surfaces 'currently compliant disclosure information' (implying partner-bank identity is disclosed) and community reporting (the Evolve Bank and Trust hack) confirms a named partner bank stands behind Treasury accounts, giving founders some visibility into the charter-holder. However, there is no first-party documentation spelling out FDIC insurance pass-through terms, what happens to customer funds if Stripe or the partner bank fails, or a clear statement of the sponsor-bank relationship structure. Missing for 10: explicit partner-bank naming and terms in docs, FDIC/insurance pass-through details, and documented failure/insolvency procedures for customers.
